description: This file contains utility functions for managing Amazon SQS queues within the Orleans streaming framework, specifically providing an asynchronous method to delete all queues used by a particular provider and cluster.

classes.name: SQSStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing SQS queues in the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedQueues
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes all queues associated with a specific provider and cluster ID by initializing each queue and invoking their delete operations.
